title: Fix embedding clients: propagate endpoint.Headers to HTTP requests
description:
Fix P2 from E2E wiring review: embedding clients silently drop provider-level headers.

All 3 embedding clients (openai, google, cohere) fail to apply endpoint.Headers to HTTP requests. Chat stream clients do this correctly via applyHeaders(). Embedding clients need the same treatment.

Files to fix:
- internal/ai/provider/openai/embedding.go (or equivalent) — add endpoint.Headers propagation
- internal/ai/provider/google/embedding.go — same
- internal/ai/provider/cohere/embedding.go — same
- Also apply EmbeddingModel.Headers if present (parity with Model.Headers in chat)

Add a test verifying headers propagate for embedding requests.

Reference: docs/plans/01-ai-core.add03-e2e-wiring-review.md (P2-F1)
